title: Delannoy differences: exact valuations and the two-adic image
description:
Research preprint by C�sar Augusto Grisa (Independent Researcher), version 1.1.0, 17 November 2026. This revision classifies the exact 2-adic valuation of D(M)-D(N) for all distinct nonnegative indices, gives all scales of shifted dyadic differences, and derives the odd-multiplier law.

The two-adic interpolation is shown to be injective, with precisely two critical points and an explicitly described image of normalized Haar measure 1/7. Refined cubic and quartic congruences include a proof of sharp uniform cubic precision. Proofs and exact reproduction scripts are supplied.

The manuscript has not been independently peer reviewed or accepted by a journal. The literature comparison explicitly credits known special cases and does not certify universal priority. The original finite NEG dataset is preserved as supplementary material, with its limitations stated; it is not a premise of the universal proof.

This revision is maintained on a separate GitHub branch. The earlier main branch and the manuscript submitted to Houston Journal of Mathematics are preserved.
